summary.text: Kirk Haskins is a Democratic state representative from Kansas House District 53 who has represented the district since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Haskins has worked as a university professor and as a bank senior vice president.

paragraphs.text: Kirk Haskins earned a bachelor's degree in communications from Washburn University in 1993, a master's degree from Wichita State University, and a doctorate in higher education administration from the University of Kansas in 2018.

His career has included work as an associate professor and chair of graduate studies with the Baker University School of Professional and Graduate Studies, as an adjunct professor with the Washburn University School of Business, and as a senior vice president with CoreFirst Bank & Trust.

Haskins has also served as Kansas board president of the Jump$tart Coalition for Personal Financial Literacy, on the community investment committee of the United Way of Greater Topeka, and on the board of trustees of the MBA Research & Curriculum Center.
Haskins won the District 53 seat in 2022, succeeding Jim Gartner, and took office on January 9, 2023.

In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Insurance, House Federal and State Affairs and Higher Education Budget committees, and he is the ranking minority member of the Elections and Information Technology committees.
